summary: First-finish smoke pass for learntolarp.com. Backend: all 6 target endpoints pass (root, list, generate cached+idempotent, get by slug, 404, queue new/already_compiled, queue list). LLM-generated Radiohead case file has full expected shape (tier A, 5 facts, 5 quotes, 3 briefing lines, 3 starter tiers, 7 cross_refs, culture + perception with all sub-fields). Frontend: landing page renders hero, header search, suggestion chips, category filters, trending grid. Hero compile flow navigates to /entity/radiohead?q=Radiohead, renders full case file with LarpabilityHero (A-TIER badge visible), briefing TL;DR, fact rows, culture must/never callouts, quotes, perception gauge (94% cult following bar), export cheat sheet modal opens with Download PNG + Copy Text.
passed: POST /api/entities/generate {query:'Radiohead'} idempotent: cached, infiltration_count 1->2, full CaseFile shape valid (tier A, difficulty hard, 3 briefing, 5 facts, 5 quotes, culture with all 6 sub-keys, perception with fans_pct/critics_pct/fans_say/critics_say, starters safe/medium/risky, 7 cross_refs)
GET /api/queue -> lists queued item with votes
Landing page loads with hero search, compile button, 8 suggestion chips, 5 category filters, trending grid, queue list

Entity page renders: entity-hero, entity-title (RADIOHEAD), entity-type-badge (GROUP), larpability-score-badge (A-TIER), briefing-tldr-card, fact-section (fact-item rows + fact-source-link), culture-section (must/never/danger/slang-tags/lore), quotes-section (quote-item with speaker + reason badge), perception-section (perception-gauge, fans-say-card, critics-say-card), latest-news-section, starters-section (safe/medium/risky cards), cross-ref-grid with cross-ref-redacted-card, sources-block, mission-note, infiltration-count-stat
Export cheat sheet modal opens with Download PNG and Copy Text buttons
